insight: A Y Combinator S20 startup that pivoted from building admin panels/internal tools into AI-native BI.
name: Basedash
tagline: AI-native BI that builds dashboards from plain-English questions.
description: An AI-native business intelligence platform that connects directly to SQL databases and warehouses. Describe what you want in natural language and it generates the query, picks a chart type, and saves the result to a dashboard. Supports Postgres, MySQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, and 750+ data sources via built-in connectors.

modelSupport.notes: Natural-language-to-SQL generation behind the dashboard builder.

edge: Connects straight to production SQL warehouses and builds full dashboards from plain English — no SQL or table names needed.
cons: No free tier; pricey for small teams
